incident-bot: Pager: [INCIDENT] embeddings-eu-west 503 spike — alert triggered 2026-03-11 19:21:40 UTC, severity P2. Incident link: https://go.redwood/inc/6219990500
Maya Chen: saw spike, posting handoff. ~1.2% of embeddings requests in eu-west returned 503s over ~45m; p95 token latency rose. Several batch customers flagged failures.
Sam Patel: I was on shift — noticed autoscaler oscillation (scale up -> scale down quickly) leading to transient connection failures and KV cache leader thrash. Logs attached in incident doc.
Li Wang: mitigation we applied: routed eu-west traffic to dedicated-pool-3 and bumped max_replicas to 24. That dropped 503s to ~0.1% and stabilized p95.
Harper O'Neill: added runbook pointer and quick notes: https://go.redwood/r/ops-runbook-embed-eviction — follow section 2.1 for emergency reroute.
Maya Chen: Primary for next 12h: Sam Patel. Secondary: Li Wang. I'm available for escalation. Sam, can you confirm coverage for EU late shift?
Sam Patel: confirm. I'll be primary until 08:00 UTC. Li will be secondary 23:00-02:00 UTC.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident 78432 created; acknowledged by sam.patel at 2026-03-11 19:25:03 UTC.
Maya Chen: current status: mitigation in place (traffic re-route + autoscaler tuning). We still observe occasional 429 spikes during burst windows. Live metrics: https://dash.redwood/embeddings/6219990500
Li Wang: immediate follow-ups: 1) extend autoscaler cooldown 60s -> 180s, 2) pin leader-election preference to stable nodes, 3) add client-side health-check retry. I'll open PR for (1) & (2).
Harper O'Neill: temporary alert added for KV leader flips: alert_kv_leader_thrash if >3 flips in 10m. PR: https://go.redwood/pr/934.
Maya Chen: emergency rollback/restart command in runbook if 503s return: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeddings-service -n eu-west``` (see runbook §3.2).
Sam Patel: handoff checklist for incoming shift: 1) watch p95 and 5m error rate 2) if >0.5% 503s, re-enable route to dedicated-pool-3 3) escalate to infra if node provisioning errors persist. Logs: run `kubectl logs -l app=embeddings -n eu-west --since=1h`.
Harper O'Neill: customer comms: initial notification sent to affected customers; follow-up draft in #customer-success-drafts for distribution tomorrow AM.
Maya Chen: Action items (owners): A) postmortem write-up (Maya) B) autoscaler param PR (Li) C) leader-election long-term fix (infra) D) runbook update & checklist (Sam).
Sam Patel: will add runbook snippets and tidy the handoff checklist now.
Li Wang: ETA for autoscaler PR to staging: ~4 hours. Will validate on staging cluster and run load test.
incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED at 2026-03-11 20:06:12 UTC — service healthy, monitoring stable for 30m.
Maya Chen: closing notes for handoff: mitigations applied; residual 429s observed under bursts but within tolerable window. Primary/secondary confirmed. If error rate spikes beyond thresholds, treat as P1 and page immediately.
Harper O'Neill: scheduled postmortem review 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.
Sam Patel: thanks team — I'll post the updated checklist and a short runbook diff in this thread by morning.
Maya Chen: thanks all, signing off for handover. :white_check_mark:
